import copy
import unittest

from solution import apply_catalog_commands


def item(sku, label="Item", price=100):
    return {"sku": sku, "label": label, "price_cents": price}


class ApplyCatalogCommandsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_commands_apply_in_order_and_preserve_order(self):
        catalog = {
            "books": [item("b1", "One", 100), item("b2", "Two", 200)],
            "games": [item("g1", "Game", 300)],
        }
        commands = [
            {"op": "remove", "category": "books", "sku": "b1"},
            {"op": "add", "category": "books", "item": item("b3", "Three", 350)},
            {"op": "remove", "category": "games", "sku": "g1"},
        ]
        catalog_before = copy.deepcopy(catalog)
        commands_before = copy.deepcopy(commands)
        result = apply_catalog_commands(catalog, commands)

        self.assertEqual(list(result), ["books", "games"])
        self.assertEqual(result, {"books": [item("b2", "Two", 200), item("b3", "Three", 350)], "games": []})
        self.assertEqual(catalog, catalog_before)
        self.assertEqual(commands, commands_before)
        self.assertIsNot(result["books"][0], catalog["books"][1])
        self.assertIsNot(result["books"][1], commands[1]["item"])
        result["books"][1]["label"] = "Changed"
        self.assertEqual(commands[1]["item"]["label"], "Three")

    def test_empty_commands_return_full_deep_copy(self):
        catalog = {"c": [item("x")]}
        commands = []
        result = apply_catalog_commands(catalog, commands)
        self.assertEqual(result, catalog)
        self.assertIsNot(result, catalog)
        self.assertIsNot(result["c"], catalog["c"])
        self.assertIsNot(result["c"][0], catalog["c"][0])

    def test_duplicate_and_missing_operations_are_transactional(self):
        catalog = {"c": [item("x")]}
        commands = [
            {"op": "add", "category": "c", "item": item("y")},
            {"op": "remove", "category": "c", "sku": "missing"},
        ]
        before_catalog = copy.deepcopy(catalog)
        before_commands = copy.deepcopy(commands)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            apply_catalog_commands(catalog, commands)
        self.assertEqual(catalog, before_catalog)
        self.assertEqual(commands, before_commands)

        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            apply_catalog_commands(catalog, [{"op": "add", "category": "c", "item": item("x")}])

    def test_catalog_validation(self):
        cases = [
            ([], TypeError),
            ({1: []}, TypeError),
            ({"": []}, ValueError),
            ({"c": {}}, TypeError),
            ({"c": [[]]}, TypeError),
            ({"c": [{"sku": "x"}]}, ValueError),
            ({"c": [{**item("x"), "extra": 1}]}, ValueError),
            ({"c": [item(1)]}, TypeError),
            ({"c": [item("")]}, ValueError),
            ({"c": [item("x", price=True)]}, TypeError),
            ({"c": [item("x", price=-1)]}, ValueError),
            ({"c": [item("x"), item("x")]}, ValueError),
        ]
        for catalog, error in cases:
            with self.subTest(catalog=catalog):
                with self.assertRaises(error):
                    apply_catalog_commands(catalog, [])

    def test_command_validation(self):
        catalog = {"c": []}
        cases = [
            ({}, ValueError),
            ([], TypeError),
            ({"op": "move", "category": "c", "sku": "x"}, ValueError),
            ({"op": "remove", "category": "c", "sku": ""}, ValueError),
            ({"op": "remove", "category": "missing", "sku": "x"}, ValueError),
            ({"op": "add", "category": "c", "item": {"sku": "x"}}, ValueError),
            ({"op": "add", "category": "c", "item": item("x"), "extra": 1}, ValueError),
        ]
        for command, error in cases:
            with self.subTest(command=command):
                with self.assertRaises(error):
                    apply_catalog_commands(catalog, [command])
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            apply_catalog_commands(catalog, {})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
